title: Bounded Counter Run
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $w$ be a Boolean word. If the input is the self-delimiting encoding of the unary word $1^n$ paired with $w$, then for every $j\le 2n$ the specified machine has a finite run from its counter state with input head at position $1$, counter value $0$, and work-tape head at $0$, to its counter state with input head at position $1+j$, counter value $j$, and work-tape head at $0$. Before the run ends, the work-tape head stays between $-1$ and $\lvert\operatorname{bits}(2n)\rvert$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: The input $y$ equals the encoding of $1^n$ paired with $w$
